row.notes: Issue drive-through penalty: param_2 = infringement record (byte car idx at +0, +9 extra), param_3 = infringement reason (byte, < 0x3d; 0x22 special-cased). Tail-jumped from the penalty handlers 0x143571b15 and 0x14357374d. Skips when the session is not live ([+0x1c70]+0x50 +0x78). For a car whose participant +0x32 has bit 0x20: books it into the per-car penalty slots ([+0x1cc0]+0x68 stride 0x28, up to min(4, g 0x145f96454) entries, slot time from the session clock) or, when full, posts a warning message (vtable 0x1456d0840) and counts it; records the penalty (0x1435668e0, 0x143573400 with reason and lap), FUN_143573b40, posts the penalty bus message (vtable 0x14584ec18, reason byte) to [0x14618b3b8]+8, stores the reason in the HUD/UI object (+0x1100) and fires UI event 0x1458499d1. (used by vmknolle race-start to cancel start penalties)
